session_note: The Nevada Legislature meets in regular session only in odd-numbered years (biennial, constitutionally limited to 120 days). NELIS's own 83rd (2025) Session Information page states: 'The 83rd Session adjourned Sine Die on June 3, 2025.' There is no 84th regular session until 2027 (NELIS lists '84th (2027) Session' as the next one; no 2026 regular session exists). However, Governor Lombardo DID call a special session in 2025-2026: the 36th (2025) Special Session convened November 13, 2025 and adjourned Sine Die on November 19, 2025 (confirmed via NELIS session-info page and the Governor's Proclamation PDF at leg.state.nv.us/Session/36th2025Special/Docs/Proclamation.pdf). The Proclamation's authorized business was limited to: motor vehicle short-term-lease insurance (SB194), a Statewide Health Care Access and Recruitment Program (SB434), a public-safety/criminal-justice omnibus bill (SB457), a film/motion-picture production-studio infrastructure tax-credit act (AB238, 'Nevada Studio Infrastructure Jobs and Workforce Training Act'), alcoholic-beverage regulation (AB404), a Windsor Park housing relocation program (SB450 from the 82nd Session), a Legislative Department land-parcel/NRS-organization cleanup (AB600 from the 83rd Session), cybersecurity, a general assistance program, school-zone traffic safety, privacy of public officers' information, wages and hours, and specified appropriations. None of these authorized topics touch data centers, energy/utility siting, tax abatements under NRS 360.754/360.750s, or NRS 704 public-utility definitions, and the special session's own subject-matter restriction (Nev. Const. art. V, sec. 9: the Legislature 'shall not introduce, consider or pass any bills except those related to the business for which the Legislature has been specially convened') means it legally could not have reopened or amended any of these 7 bills. All 7 bills below reached their final regular-session dispositions between April 12, 2025 and June 10, 2025, well before the special session even convened, so the special session had zero effect on them. This confirms the 2025 dispositions captured in the original packet are final and will not change absent a future 2027 regular session or a new special session on this topic.
